knxUltimateHueController.editor_unavailable: The selected Hue editor is unavailable. Restart Node-RED after updating the package.
knxUltimateHueController.hue_device_placeholder: Search your Hue device or resource
knxUltimateHueController.loading_hue_devices: Connecting to the Hue Bridge and loading devices…
knxUltimateHueController.no_devices: No Hue resources found. Check the Hue Bridge and press refresh.
knxUltimateHueController.hue_bridge_not_ready: The Hue Bridge did not become ready. Check its connection and reopen the editor.
knxUltimateHueController.knx_gateway_required_for_mappings: To display the group-address mappings, select a KNX gateway. Without one, this node can only be controlled by input messages from the flow.
knxUltimateHueController.legacy_node_notice: This legacy HUE node is deprecated. Use the new HUE Controller node for new flows.
knxUltimateHueController.migration_button_title: Convert all legacy HUE nodes in the editor
knxUltimateHueController.migration_video_title: Watch the legacy HUE conversion guide on YouTube
knxUltimateHueController.migration_disclaimer: Conversion happens entirely in your browser. No flow or node data is sent anywhere. Afterwards, only an editable email draft opens and nothing is sent automatically. The donation page opens only if you choose the optional support button in the final message.
knxUltimateHueController.migration_confirm: {{count}} legacy HUE nodes will be converted directly in the editor.
knxUltimateHueController.migration_privacy: Conversion happens entirely in this browser. No flow, node, configuration, credential, group address, or wiring data is transmitted or retained.
knxUltimateHueController.migration_email_notice: After conversion, your email app will open an editable draft addressed to the author without navigating away from Node-RED. The draft contains only the number of converted nodes and space for optional notes; nothing is sent automatically. The final Node-RED message will offer an optional button to support KNX Ultimate.
knxUltimateHueController.migration_email_subject: KNX Ultimate - legacy HUE conversion used
knxUltimateHueController.migration_email_body:
Hello Massimo,

I used the legacy HUE node conversion button.
Converted legacy HUE nodes: {{count}}.

Optional notes:
knxUltimateHueController.migration_email_failed: The nodes were converted, but the email draft could not be opened.
knxUltimateHueController.migration_donation_failed: The donation page could not be opened. You can try again.
knxUltimateHueController.migration_deploy_notice: Before continuing, export a backup of your flows. The current editor will close. Only the legacy HUE nodes will be changed; all config nodes and wiring remain untouched. Review the result, then click Deploy yourself.
knxUltimateHueController.migration_review_notice: Safety check: after conversion, inspect every modified HUE node in the flow. Verify its selected function, configuration references, input/output pins and wiring before clicking Deploy.
knxUltimateHueController.migration_success: Process finished. {{count}} legacy HUE nodes were converted. Inspect every modified node, including its function, configuration, pins and wiring, before clicking Deploy. If this conversion saved you time, you can support the continued development of KNX Ultimate with the optional button below.
knxUltimateHueController.migration_failed: Local HUE migration failed; the flow was not changed:
knxUltimateHueController.migration_none: No legacy HUE nodes were found.
knxUltimateHueController.migration_unavailable: The HUE migration tool is unavailable. Restart Node-RED after updating the package.
